_comment: Zone cover (smart enemies T-08 slice 2, designer decision 2026-11-21; AI/PmcZoneCoverRules.h, PmcArenaCommand.cpp PlaceZoneCover). A TEST option of the PMC arena only: with arg ZoneCover=1 (CodexTactics.PmcArena and its smokes, any objective scenario) the round spawns low-cover blocks inside the objective zone, facing the attackers' approach, before the squads spawn and before the defence builds its zone posts; the round then waits for the navmesh rebuild and the blocks are destroyed at the round's end. In the real game the level generator places cover at defended goals. Approach = from the zone centre toward the point where the attackers' nav path (spawn -> objective) enters the zone, else toward the attackers' spawn. Layout: slot 0 centred centre_dist_m out on the approach bearing, slots 1 / 2 side_dist_m out at +-side_angle_deg; every block's long side (length_cm) perpendicular to the approach (side_yaw_follow 1 turns the side blocks toward their own bearing); a block must lie fully inside the zone radius minus edge_margin_cm (else pulled in by pull_in_step_cm, never nearer than min_dist_m, else dropped). height_cm 80 = LOW cover a crouched man shoots over (ai/zone-cover-80, 2026-11-22: the 110 cm blocks blinded the crouched defenders, see the T-08 ZoneCover autopsy; CoverTraceRules low cover <= 130 cm, knee trace 45 cm). World side: a block is skipped (logged) when it is off the navmesh, its ground lies more than ground_max_dz_cm off the objective's level, it overlaps world geometry, or its footprint comes within spawn_clear_m of either side's spawn. This file is not read by the night trainer (not pmc_commander.json): its numbers are no genes.
